component.name: Lunch Tray
component.summary: What's for lunch at your canteen

description.p: Lunch Tray shows the menus of more than 1300 canteens listed on OpenMensa. Pick your canteen, browse the days of the week and see the prices for your group.

ul.li: Searchable list of all canteens on OpenMensa
Prices for students, employees and guests
Remembers your canteen and shows the last saved menu when you are offline
Allergen and dietary notes with icons for vegan and vegetarian meals, where the canteen provides them

description.p: Lunch Tray is not affiliated with OpenMensa.

screenshot.caption: Menu of the day with prices for students
